matches.text: ## D008 — Facturación

Impact: [business-rules.md](business-rules.md), §§15, 23, 26–28, mantiene la validación profesional pendiente del sistema de suplidos, arquitectura fiscal y tratamiento exacto de Tararí. Las condiciones futuras de la web deberán incorporar mandato expreso de gestión/administración/pago por cuenta del cliente y conservar la versión aceptada; no se modifica esa web ahora. D008 y P16 siguen íntegros.

oracles.AUD01: External outputs all seven surfaces and three destinations contain exactly commercial fields; reserved/personal/foreign marker searches return zero, cursor cannot cross destination/context.
oracles.AUD02: Current administrator positive; forged plain object, foreign verified subject/session, future role metadata, background interaction and separately provisioned actor scope cannot read/mutate source.
oracles.AUD03: Every crm_private table protected against SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE by runtime/anon/authenticated; protected identity or signing attributes cannot be changed.
oracles.AUD04: Private binary delivered only with current authority/context/purpose; foreign context and revoked session denied; bytes original unchanged.
oracles.AUD05: Explicit synthetic original and derivatives distinct; tentative candidate cannot override confirmed18; no audio/consent/retention/deletion inference; rollback then same retry succeeds once.
oracles.AUD06: External supplier documentary lifecycle preserves external issuer; fiscal emission/numbering/series and explicit override remain denied even after internal approval; no business mutations from projections.
oracles.AUD07: Technical observation strips injected message/secret/URL/economics, preserves cause and reference, independently scoped reads cannot enumerate foreign root; revocation denies historic replay.
oracles.AUD08: External received event remains received/review pending, deduplicated and cannot mutate Booking; unverified/foreign source rejected.
